input.question: Who is the band associated with the album "Interiors"?

documents.text: by Quicksand New York City post-hardcore band Quicksand have released Interiors , their first album in 22 years . Interiors features the band ’ s original ( and only ) lineup of drummer Alan Cage , frontman/guitarist Walter Schreifels , bassist Sergio Vega , and guitarist Tom Capone . The album will be released on November 10 on Epitaph . Recorded at Studio 4 Recording in Conshohocken , Pennsylvania , Interiors was produced and engineered by Will Yip ( The Menzingers , Title Fight , Pianos Become the Teeth ) .
